milestones.label: Application deadline depends on the host university (Type B)
milestones.source_text: Type B is applied for through the host university, so each university sets its own closing date. Official examples for the 2027 intake are listed in the following entries.

milestones.label: Application deadline (university example: Peking University, 2027 entry)
milestones.source_text: Peking University's international students office gives 25 December 2026 as the closing date of its general graduate application, which also covers scholarship consideration.

milestones.label: Application deadline (university example: Zhejiang University, doctoral, Type B)
milestones.source_text: Zhejiang University's International College lists 31 December 2026 as the deadline for the Chinese Government Scholarship through its university route (doctoral programmes).

milestones.label: Application deadline (university example: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, final date)
milestones.source_text: Shanghai Jiao Tong University's guide gives 15 December 2026 as the first round and 15 February 2027 as the final date for the Chinese Government Scholarship through the university.
